hero.subtitle: Topic-based vocabulary, TOEIC practice tests, dictation and head-to-head word games – all in one place, with study suggestions based on your own results.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of the English learning platform

preview.label: Today's flashcard
preview.example: She stayed resilient after every setback.

features.title: One platform, five ways to practise
features.subtitle: Each area is built for its own goal, yet they share one learning record so you always know where you stand.

vocabulary.title: Remember words longer with spaced repetition
vocabulary.body: Study topic collections, save your own words and get reminded to review right before you forget.
vocabulary.point3: A personal notebook for new words

toeic.title: TOEIC practice that feels like the real test
toeic.body: Take single parts or timed full tests, then see your converted score and explanations right after you submit.

dictation.title: Dictation for natural listening comprehension
dictation.body: Listen sentence by sentence, type what you hear and get detailed feedback on every word you miss.
dictation.point3: Pinpoints exactly which words you missed

games.title: Review through games
games.body: Speed typing, word shooting, meaning guessing – turn review into short, fun rounds.

arena.title: Challenge friends in the arena
arena.body: Play ranked matches or open a room with friends, answer fast and accurately to climb the leaderboard.

how.title: Three steps to get into the habit
how.step1Body: Sign up with email or Google in under a minute.
how.step2Body: Start with a vocabulary collection, a TOEIC test or a listening lesson that suits you.
how.step3Body: Keep your streak, get review suggestions and watch your progress week by week.

cta.title: Ready for your first lesson?
cta.subtitle: Create an account and start with a few minutes a day. Progress comes from consistency.
